title: cyperus nutans subsp. subprolixus
intro: Cyperus nutans subsp. subprolixus, commonly known as the umbrella sedge, is a type of plant that belongs to the sedge family (Cyperaceae). It is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, alleviating respiratory issues, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of the umbrella sedge include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which contribute to its use in treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of Cyperus nutans subsp. subprolixus include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
